# CaliLawyer.com
> CaliLawyer.com is a Glendale firm for California personal injury and lemon law. We take cases in Glendale, Burbank, Pasadena, and Los Angeles. Attorney: Rober A. Terziyan, State Bar of California No. 351959. Free consultation. Phone: (310) 331-0310. Languages: English, Armenian, and Spanish.

## Pages
- [Home](https://calilawyer.com/): CaliLawyer.com in Glendale. Free consultation. We handle cases on contingency.
- [Attorney](https://calilawyer.com/attorneys/robby-terziyan): Rober A. Terziyan, State Bar of California No. 351959.
- [Lemon law](https://calilawyer.com/lemon-law): Used vehicles may qualify, case by case.
- [California lemon law deadlines](https://calilawyer.com/lemon-law/deadlines): See CCP §871.21 and §871.29.
- [Used and leased vehicles](https://calilawyer.com/lemon-law/used-cpo-leased): Used vehicles may qualify, case by case.
- [Personal injury](https://calilawyer.com/injury): Generally 2 years from the injury (CCP §335.1). Public-entity claims generally must be presented within 6 months (Gov. Code §911.2).
- [Personal injury attorney fees](https://calilawyer.com/injury/attorney-fees): We handle cases on contingency.
